response.justification: Despite extensive software engineering experience, the candidate lacks direct C++ development experience in industrial automation, high-performance systems, or secure embedded environments required for this role; their work is primarily in TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, and web technologies, with only a brief, outdated C++ stint at National Instruments over a decade ago, insufficient to meet core competency requirements.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience across diverse domains and languages
Strong track record in open-source contributions and technical mentoring
Proven ability in event-driven systems, CI/CD, and agile practices
concerns: No recent or substantial C++/STL development in high-performance or industrial contexts
Lacks demonstrated experience with IEC 62443, MQTT, REST in industrial IoT, or secure SDLC
No evidence of multi-threaded, networked system design for on-prem/cloud automation platforms
